appearance_facts.location: The blue solid line series, labeled on the left as 'High fibre breakfast cereals', at the '11-18 years' characteristic.
appearance_facts.fact: The data point is a blue circle positioned at the lowest vertical level of this entire series. A large blue '18' label is printed directly above the adjacent '4-10 years' point, not this one.

appearance_facts.location: The red dashed line series, labeled on the right as 'Other breakfast cereals', at the '11-18 years' characteristic.
appearance_facts.fact: The data point is a red square positioned at the highest vertical level of this entire series, forming the peak of the line.

appearance_facts.location: The blue solid line series at the '19-64 years' characteristic.
appearance_facts.fact: The data point is a blue circle with a '20' label printed just above it.

appearance_facts.location: The red dashed line series at the '19-64 years' characteristic.
appearance_facts.fact: The data point is a red square with a '6' label printed just below it.

appearance_facts.location: The red dashed line series at the '4-10 years' characteristic.
appearance_facts.fact: The data point is a red square with a '10' label printed just below it.

appearance_facts.location: The blue solid line series at the '1.5-3 years' and '65 years and over' characteristics.
appearance_facts.fact: The '1.5-3 years' point is a blue circle at a mid-level. The '65 years and over' point is a blue circle at the highest vertical level of the blue series.

appearance_facts.location: The red dashed line series at the '1.5-3 years' and '65 years and over' characteristics.
appearance_facts.fact: The '1.5-3 years' point is a red square at the lowest vertical level of the red series. The '65 years and over' point is a red square at a low level, similar to the '19-64 years' point.

printed_facts.fact: Title: 'High fibre breakfast cereals vs Other breakfast cereals'.

printed_facts.location: Bottom horizontal axis tick labels, left to right.
printed_facts.fact: '1.5-3 years', '4-10 years', '11-18 years', '19-64 years', '65 years and over'.
Blue '18' is above the '4-10 years' blue point. Red '10' is below the '4-10 years' red point. Blue '20' is above the '19-64 years' blue point. Red '6' is below the '19-64 years' red point.

public_definitions: Use the displayed comparison for the 11-18 years age group to determine which cereal category should be escalated for adolescent fibre-support follow-up, or whether it should be sent for general reference review.
